purpose: Define a deterministic, inspection-only binding preview between the hash-bound D9.10 PREPARE_ONLY envelope and a proposed D-owned renderer contract without emitting renderer-native input or invoking a renderer.

preview_contract.purpose: Inspection object only. It is not renderer-native input, a dispatch request, a render job or authorization.

binding_rules.content_identity: Copy canonical D plan selection; immutable identity only.
binding_rules.editorial_values: Copy only model-allowlisted fields; preserve values exactly as resolved by D9.9.
binding_rules.slot_ids: PROPOSED_NOT_APPROVED; these IDs are candidate review targets, not current renderer API fields.
binding_rules.delivery_profile: Resolve only by the existing delivery registry; record registry and resolved-profile hashes.
binding_rules.presentation_profile: Pass through the exact canonical profile identifier; do not infer or synthesize values. This preview does not independently resolve the profile.
binding_rules.variation_index: Explicit canonical value only; no runtime derivation.
binding_rules.gameplay_seed: canonical request seed; GAMEPLAY domain only.
binding_rules.music_seed: canonical request music_seed; MUSIC domain only.
binding_rules.determinism: Canonical JSON hashing; no timestamp, random ID, environment path or worker/runtime details in preview identity.

forbidden_operations: bind SimulationResult, winning_frame, close_calls or derived telemetry
modify C11-C source or its frozen manifest
